GTI_SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
GTI_SETTINGS.NOTICE_FAILED: The action worked, but the message to the customer could not be sent
GTI_SETTINGS.NO_WHATSAPP: This company has no WhatsApp connection yet. Ratings and business hours apply to WhatsApp connections, so they start working once one is added.

GENERAL.TITLE: General
GENERAL.RATINGS_HINT: After a conversation is resolved, the customer is asked to rate the service.
GENERAL.TRANSFER_PLACEHOLDER: You have been transferred to the {queue} queue.
GENERAL.VARIABLES: Available variables: {variables}. Leave empty to send nothing.

TIMEOUTS.TITLE: Waiting times
TIMEOUTS.CLOSE_AFTER_HINT: Leave empty to never close automatically. Minimum: {min} minutes.
TIMEOUTS.CLOSE_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: We are closing this conversation. Send a message whenever you need us.
TIMEOUTS.CHATBOT_NOTE: The chatbot and no-queue timeouts come with the n8n bot (Malu) once it is connected to Work.

OFFICE.TITLE: Business hours
OFFICE.ACTION_PENDING: Keep as pending and reply with the message below
OFFICE.MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: We are closed right now. We will reply as soon as we are back.

HOURS.WEEKLY_DESCRIPTION: Set the regular business hours for each day of the week. Days without a rule are closed.
HOURS.INVALID_RULE: Each rule needs at least one day and a closing time after the opening time
HOURS.ONE_INTERVAL: Each day has one opening interval.
